coverage: 418 discoverable authored PRs across Laravel (285), Next.js (51), and Flutter (82), their commit pages, indexed commit searches and local histories. cv_decision: User approved a two-page expanded CV preserving existing accomplishments. Added seller-list performance, Kubernetes migration and coverage gates, DANA integration, Next.js payment recovery, streamed consignment reports, and CI runner cleanup. Diff and main commit confirm implementation; production ancestry confirmed.

laravel.recommendation: For backend roles, seller-list optimization is the strongest new accomplishment and a stronger replacement for the proposed Go migration bullet.
